passage:
accessible — 易接近的；可获得的
It should be accessible to everyone.

expertise — 专业知识
The idea is simple: expertise should not stay hidden in universities or laboratories.

captions — 字幕
Second, the library provides live captions on screens for people who are hard of hearing.

jargon — 行话；专业术语
The library trains them to avoid jargon and to use examples from daily life.

volunteers — 志愿者
Third, volunteers sit at tables after each talk to answer individual questions.

residents — 居民
'The best part was hearing older residents describe their childhoods,' the historian said.

curious — 好奇的
'We want them to become curious and confident.' The Open Archive shows that institutions can make expertise accessible when they design for real people, not just for experts.

independently — 独立地
Chen hopes this will encourage more people to explore topics independently.
